messages:
erin: FYI I merged a small change that adds a top-level "module" and "browser" field to the SDK package.json to help some bundlers. Regrettably it caused our samples and a couple of customers to hit weird resolution/typing issues.

samir: ugh. what symptoms are folks seeing?

erin: two things: 1) pnpm workspace users get TS errors because types resolution prefers the module field and ends up following ESM-only types that point at a file we didn't publish for canaries. 2) Edge bundlers (esbuild-based) started rewriting imports to a different subpath and runtime throws "Cannot find module".

kai: can you paste the published package.json exports/types part from the tgz?

erin: snippet from unpacked canary tarball:
```json
"module": "dist/esm/index.js",
"browser": "dist/esm/browser.js",
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./lib/*": "./dist/lib/*.js"
}
```

erin: the problem was our pack omitted dist/esm/index.d.ts for the canary and the browser field encouraged bundlers to pick the wrong entry for edge bundles.

samir: yep that matches reported errors. pnpm+TS will prefer the module/types combo and then fail when the d.ts is missing. esbuild in edge mode is prone to preferring "browser" over conditional exports in some configs.

kai: short fixes: 1) rollback canary and republish ensuring both esm/cjs JS and d.ts artifacts are included. 2) keep exports conditional (import/require) and avoid relying on top-level module/browser fields where possible. 3) add pack-time validation: unpack tgz and assert exports entries and that referenced paths exist.

erin: agreed. I'll open a rollback + patch. Also adding three CI checks: a) node-18 dynamic-import smoke test, b) pnpm workspace TS compile smoke test, c) edge bundler smoke that builds the sample.

pack-bot: publish job 224 failed: pack validation detected missing file dist/esm/index.d.ts in canary tgz. See log https://ci.internal/pack/224

ci-bot: job 224 (pnpm workspace smoke) failed in samples/next-starter: TS error: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations. logs: https://ci.internal/job/224

samir: thanks for the quick catch. We should also add a short devex doc section: "When editing exports, verify: import(), require(), pnpm/workspace, and edge bundlers" with commands to run locally.

kai: long term idea: ship a tiny scripts/emit-exports.js that serializes exports deterministically and a pack-verify script that runs during publish. That will prevent ad-hoc edits causing these subtle mismatches.

erin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1580 - rollback canary, add pack-verify, and three CI smoke tests. Will update onboarding doc and post a note in #announce after merge.

samir: also add a non-blocking lint rule to warn when someone adds top-level module/browser fields without a matching exports/types policy.

erin: good call. thanks all.
